Task: Melting of Aluminum
Description: Simulate the melting of Aluminum by first equilibrating the system under NVT conditions, then relaxing it under NPT conditions, followed by a heating stage under NPT where the temperature is gradually increased to induce melting. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential and the given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each direction. Report the final density of the system in g/cm³.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)

{"path":"/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/aluminum_melting_trial_4/in.melt","content":"# LAMMPS input script for melting aluminum

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/tasks/aluminum_melting_trial_4/aluminum_data.lmp

# Potential
after_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Neighbor settings
neighbor 2.0 bin
neigh_modify delay 10

# Initial velocities
temperature 300.0 12345

# NVT Equilibration
fix 1 all nvt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1
run 10000

# NPT Relaxation
unfix 1
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 10000

# NPT Heating
unfix 1
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0
run 20000

# Output
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density
"}
